mikayel-sargsyan.name: Mikayel Sargsyan
mikayel-sargsyan.biography:
Mikayel Sargsyan is a tax and accounting professional specializing in business taxation, financial reporting, and advisory services for small and medium-sized businesses. He works closely with clients to improve tax compliance, optimize financial processes, and support strategic decision-making through accurate financial information.

His experience includes corporate accounting, tax planning, bookkeeping oversight, financial statement preparation, and advisory services across a wide range of industries. Mikayel combines technical accounting knowledge with practical business insight to help organizations navigate complex financial and tax matters.

In addition to his tax and accounting work, he has extensive experience in audit and finance leadership roles, providing clients with a comprehensive understanding of financial operations and regulatory requirements.

nanar-siravyan.name: Nanar Siravyan
nanar-siravyan.biography:
Nanar Siravyan holds a Bachelor’s degree in International Relations from Yerevan State University. She has practical experience at the Constitutional Court of Armenia, which contributed to her understanding of legal and institutional processes.

In addition to her academic and institutional background, she has participated in professional development programs in Human Resources and Financial Literacy, reflecting her commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.

Throughout her career, she has developed strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills while working across different sectors. Her professional experience includes coordinating work processes, providing customer support and communication services, and managing various administrative responsibilities, which has enabled her to build solid expertise in client relations, operational coordination, and efficient workflow management.

She is fluent in Armenian, English, Russian, and French.

yeghishe-manukyan.name: Yeghishe Manukyan
yeghishe-manukyan.biography:
Yeghishe Manukyan is an experienced accounting and tax professional with a strong background in full-cycle accounting, tax compliance, financial reporting, and audit preparation. He supports businesses in maintaining accurate accounting records, preparing reliable financial reports, managing tax filing obligations, and improving internal financial processes. Before joining Retrieve Legal & Tax, Yeghishe gained practical experience at BDO Armenia and later served as Chief Accountant at DeepWhite™, where he managed accounting operations, coordinated year-end closing, worked with external auditors, and led accounting teams. His work combines technical accuracy with a practical understanding of business needs, helping clients stay compliant, organized, and ready for financial and tax reporting requirements.

Yeghishe holds a BA in Marketing and Business Administration from the Armenian State University of Economics, has completed ACCA Financial Accounting training, and holds a certificate on the Tax Code of the Republic of Armenia. He speaks Armenian, Russian, and English.

lia-nikoghosyan.name: Lia Nikoghosyan
lia-nikoghosyan.biography:
Lia is a qualified advocate and a member of the Chamber of Advocates of the Republic of Armenia, with legal practice covering corporate, civil, and administrative law. Her experience includes both advisory and litigation work, representing and assisting clients in a wide range of legal matters. She holds a Bachelor’s degree from the Faculty of Law of Yerevan State University (2016–2020), completed the Advocates Academy (2020–2021), and obtained a Master’s degree from the Law Faculty of the Yerevan branch of Moscow State University (2022–2024).

In addition to client representation and advisory work, Lia leads a team of junior associates, overseeing their work, reviewing outputs, and ensuring the quality and consistency of legal deliverables. The role also includes task allocation, workflow coordination, and monitoring deadlines and performance across the team.

Her practice includes drafting and reviewing corporate and civil agreements, conducting legal analysis, and advising on regulatory compliance and corporate governance issues, as well as handling civil and administrative litigation matters. All work is carried out under the supervision of and reported to the Managing Partners.

 

Lia focuses on delivering practical, business-oriented legal solutions while ensuring compliance with applicable legal frameworks and procedural requirements

lilit-petrosyan.name: Lilit Petrosyan
lilit-petrosyan.biography:
Lilith Petrosyan is an Associate Lawyer at Retrieve Legal and Tax, where she assists local and international clients with practical, business-oriented legal support. She graduated in 2025 from French University of Armenia and Jean Moulin Lyon 3 University, complementing her academic background with internships, international projects, seminars, and short-term exchange programs that strengthened her comparative legal perspective.

Her work focuses on civil, contract, corporate, and labor law, with an emphasis on structuring reliable legal frameworks and supporting companies’ day-to-day legal needs.

2025

Bachelor of Laws (LL.B) French University of Armenia and Jean Moulin Lyon 3 University

anahit-petrosyan.name: Anahit Petrosyan
anahit-petrosyan.biography:
Anahit is a lawyer with a focus on corporate and commercial law. She advises businesses and individuals on a broad range of legal matters, combining strong academic training with practical experience in both the public and private sectors. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Law from the French University in Armenia (UFAR) (dual degree program with University Jean Moulin Lyon 3)

Her practice includes corporate governance, contract drafting and review, legal research, and regulatory compliance. Through her experience at the Central Bank of Armenia, private law firms, and the Legal Clinic of the Université Française en Arménie, Anahit has developed a practical understanding of the legal and commercial challenges faced by modern businesses. She approaches legal matters with a balance of analytical precision and commercial awareness, helping clients identify effective and pragmatic solutions.

Anahit holds a Bachelor of Laws from the Université Française en Arménie, awarded in partnership with the Université Jean Moulin Lyon 3. Alongside her  legal practice, she has participated in a number of international academic and professional development programs, strengthening her expertise in advocacy, negotiation, and cross-border legal issues.

Committed to delivering clear, reliable, and business-oriented legal support, Anahit values building trusted relationships with clients and addressing legal challenges with professionalism and attention to detail. She works in Armenian, English, French, and Russian.

larisa-petrosyan.name: Larisa Petrosyan
larisa-petrosyan.biography:
Larisa is an Associate lawyer specializing in corporate, contract, and employment law, and advises companies and individuals on a broad range of legal matters, with a focus on delivering clear, practical, and commercially sound solutions.

Her practice covers corporate governance, drafting and reviewing commercial contracts, employment law
matters, regulatory compliance, legal research, and legal analysis. Known for her approachable, detail-oriented manner, she provides clear and reliable legal support, helping clients navigate complex legal frameworks while aligning legal strategies with their business objectives and building trusted professional relationships.

A graduate of the French University in Armenia (UFAR) (dual degree program with University Jean Moulin Lyon 3), Larisa combines solid academic training with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset. She is fluent in English, French, and Russian, enabling her to work effectively with both local and international clients.

Alongside her core practice, she maintains a strong interest in human rights, data protection, and AI law, which informs the careful, forward-thinking, and principled approach she brings to her legal work.

feliks-hovakimyan.name: Feliks Hovakimyan, Esq.
feliks-hovakimyan.biography:
Feliks Hovakimyan, Esq. is a dual-licensed attorney admitted to practice law in California and Armenia, advising businesses and individuals on Corporate Law, Banking & Finance, Civil Litigation, Investment Law, Immigration Law and Cross-Border Commercial Transactions. He represents clients across a variety of industries, including technology, healthcare, finance, and professional services.

As the Founder and Managing Director of Retrieve Legal & Tax, Feliks is known for his practical, business-oriented approach, strategic thinking, and commitment to achieving effective solutions for his clients. His combination of legal expertise and business insight enables him to deliver clear, commercially sound advice in complex matters.

aleksandr-harutyunyan.name: Aleksandr Harutyunyan
aleksandr-harutyunyan.biography:
Aleksandr is an experienced Attorney with a demonstrated history of working in the legal services industry with work experience in New York, Paris and Yerevan. Primarily a constitutionalist, he is skilled in arbitration, international business transactions, negotiation, political science, ECHR, international relations, international law. Clients previously represented by Aleksandr, among others, include some of the major construction, advertising and health industry companies in Armenia. He also has demonstrated skills in representing international clients.

By delving into the financial and legal complexities that confront both public and private enterprises, Michael devises pragmatic resolutions for everyday business hurdles. These encompass continuous adherence to Armenian securities and corporate legislations, alongside
managing commercial agreements.

papin-karapetyan.name: Papin Karapetyan
papin-karapetyan.biography:
Papin Karapetyan is a lawyer with a strong foundation in legal research and analysis, combined with a practical, detail-oriented approach to addressing legal matters.

A graduate of Gavar State University with a Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Papin further broadened his academic and professional outlook through an Erasmus+ exchange at the University of Minho’s Faculty of Law in Portugal, where he gained insight into comparative legal systems and European legal practice.

He gained valuable practical experience through his internship at the Gavar Seat of the Court of First Instance of General Jurisdiction of Gegharkunik Province, where he was involved in observing judicial proceedings, reviewing case materials, and gaining firsthand insight into the application of Armenian law in practice. This experience provided him with a solid grounding in courtroom procedure and the practical workings of the judicial system.

His work draws on strong skills in legal research, documentation, and analysis, complemented by his ability to communicate clearly in Armenian, English, and Russian. Papin is committed to delivering accurate and practical legal support while maintaining high professional standards. His professional interests include comparative and European law, human rights, and legal research.

michael-hovhannesyan.name: Michael Hovhannesyan
michael-hovhannesyan.biography:
Michael Hovhannesyan possesses extensive expertise in various facets of corporate law, specializing in Corporate Law, Mergers and Acquisitions, and Data Protection. His proficiencies extend to industries with stringent regulations like energy and construction, as well as technology, manufacturing, and investments.

 

By delving into the financial and legal complexities that confront both public and private enterprises, Michael devises pragmatic resolutions for everyday business hurdles. These encompass continuous adherence to Armenian securities and corporate legislations, alongside
managing commercial agreements.

vache-simonyan.name: Vache Simonyan
vache-simonyan.biography:
Vache provides comprehensive legal advice and guidance to clients facing criminal charges, ensuring they understand their rights and potential legal strategies. He represents clients in various court proceedings, including pre-trial hearings, trials, and appeals, where he presents evidence, cross-examines witnesses, and makes compelling legal arguments on their behalf.

Additionally, Vache advocates for clients’ interests during interactions with law enforcement agencies such as the Ministry of Internal Affairs and the Investigative Committee. He prepares clients for court appearances, offering clarity on the legal process and what to expect.

Vache’s expertise extends to preparing legal documents like motions, briefs, and petitions, enabling him to present legal arguments effectively in court. He conducts thorough research on relevant laws, regulations, and precedents to construct a solid defense strategy tailored to each case.

By reviewing all available evidence, including police reports and precedents, Vache ensures a robust defense strategy is in place to protect his clients’ rights and interests effectively.

mariam-dovlatyan.name: Mariam Dovlatyan
mariam-dovlatyan.biography:
Mariam Dovlatyan is a qualified advocate and a member of the Chamber of Advocates of the Republic of Armenia, with over four years of legal experience advising domestic and international clients on a broad range of business-related legal matters.

Her experience includes corporate and commercial law, employment, intellectual property, immigration, regulatory compliance, and civil and administrative matters. Her work has involved drafting and reviewing commercial agreements, advising on corporate governance and regulatory issues, assisting with cross-border matters, and representing clients in civil and administrative proceedings.

At Retrieve Legal & Tax, Mariam is further developing her practice in technology-related and regulatory matters. Her professional interests include information privacy and data protection, cybersecurity, and iGaming.

Mariam holds a Bachelor’s degree in Law and a Master’s degree in International Business Law from the French University in Armenia (UFAR) and has completed the Advocates Academy of the Republic of Armenia. She is currently completing an additional LL.M. in Law & Technology at King’s College London, with an academic focus on artificial intelligence, information privacy and data protection, and cybersecurity.

She works in Armenian, English, French, and Russian.

meline-nadaryan.name: Meline Nadaryan

She is committed to delivering clear, accurate, and practical legal solutions while maintaining high professional standards.

Her professional interests include international law, human rights, corporate and regulatory matters, and legal research.

larisa-petrosyan.biography:
Larisa is an Associate lawyer specializing in corporate, contract, and employment law, and advises companies and individuals on a broad range of legal matters, with a focus on delivering clear, practical, and commercially sound solutions.

Her practice covers corporate governance, drafting and reviewing commercial contracts, employment law
matters, regulatory compliance, legal research, and legal analysis. Known for her approachable, detail-oriented manner, she provides clear and reliable legal support, helping clients navigate complex legal frameworks while aligning legal strategies with their business objectives and building trusted professional relationships.

A graduate of the French University in Armenia (UFAR) (dual degree program with University Jean Moulin Lyon 3), Larisa combines solid academic training with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset. She is fluent in English, French, and Russian, enabling her to work effectively with both local and international clients.

Alongside her core practice, she maintains a strong interest in human rights, data protection, and AI law, which informs the careful, forward-thinking, and principled approach she brings to her legal work.

feliks-hovakimyan.name: Ֆելիքս Հովակիմյան
feliks-hovakimyan.biography:
Feliks Hovakimyan, Esq. is a dual-licensed attorney admitted to practice law in California and Armenia, advising businesses and individuals on Corporate Law, Banking & Finance, Civil Litigation, Investment Law, Immigration Law and Cross-Border Commercial Transactions. He represents clients across a variety of industries, including technology, healthcare, finance, and professional services.

As the Founder and Managing Director of Retrieve Legal & Tax, Feliks is known for his practical, business-oriented approach, strategic thinking, and commitment to achieving effective solutions for his clients. His combination of legal expertise and business insight enables him to deliver clear, commercially sound advice in complex matters.

aleksandr-harutyunyan.name: Ալեքսանդր Հարությունյան
aleksandr-harutyunyan.biography:
Aleksandr is an experienced Attorney with a demonstrated history of working in the legal services industry with work experience in New York, Paris and Yerevan. Primarily a constitutionalist, he is skilled in arbitration, international business transactions, negotiation, political science, ECHR, international relations, international law. Clients previously represented by Aleksandr, among others, include some of the major construction, advertising and health industry companies in Armenia. He also has demonstrated skills in representing international clients.

By delving into the financial and legal complexities that confront both public and private enterprises, Michael devises pragmatic resolutions for everyday business hurdles. These encompass continuous adherence to Armenian securities and corporate legislations, alongside
managing commercial agreements.

papin-karapetyan.name: Պապին Կարապետյան
papin-karapetyan.biography:
Papin Karapetyan is a lawyer with a strong foundation in legal research and analysis, combined with a practical, detail-oriented approach to addressing legal matters.

A graduate of Gavar State University with a Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Papin further broadened his academic and professional outlook through an Erasmus+ exchange at the University of Minho’s Faculty of Law in Portugal, where he gained insight into comparative legal systems and European legal practice.

He gained valuable practical experience through his internship at the Gavar Seat of the Court of First Instance of General Jurisdiction of Gegharkunik Province, where he was involved in observing judicial proceedings, reviewing case materials, and gaining firsthand insight into the application of Armenian law in practice. This experience provided him with a solid grounding in courtroom procedure and the practical workings of the judicial system.

His work draws on strong skills in legal research, documentation, and analysis, complemented by his ability to communicate clearly in Armenian, English, and Russian. Papin is committed to delivering accurate and practical legal support while maintaining high professional standards. His professional interests include comparative and European law, human rights, and legal research.

michael-hovhannesyan.name: Մայքլ Հովհաննեսյան
michael-hovhannesyan.biography:
Michael Hovhannesyan possesses extensive expertise in various facets of corporate law, specializing in Corporate Law, Mergers and Acquisitions, and Data Protection. His proficiencies extend to industries with stringent regulations like energy and construction, as well as technology, manufacturing, and investments.

 

By delving into the financial and legal complexities that confront both public and private enterprises, Michael devises pragmatic resolutions for everyday business hurdles. These encompass continuous adherence to Armenian securities and corporate legislations, alongside
managing commercial agreements.

vache-simonyan.name: Վաչե Սիմոնյան
vache-simonyan.biography:
Vache provides comprehensive legal advice and guidance to clients facing criminal charges, ensuring they understand their rights and potential legal strategies. He represents clients in various court proceedings, including pre-trial hearings, trials, and appeals, where he presents evidence, cross-examines witnesses, and makes compelling legal arguments on their behalf.

Additionally, Vache advocates for clients’ interests during interactions with law enforcement agencies such as the Ministry of Internal Affairs and the Investigative Committee. He prepares clients for court appearances, offering clarity on the legal process and what to expect.

Vache’s expertise extends to preparing legal documents like motions, briefs, and petitions, enabling him to present legal arguments effectively in court. He conducts thorough research on relevant laws, regulations, and precedents to construct a solid defense strategy tailored to each case.

By reviewing all available evidence, including police reports and precedents, Vache ensures a robust defense strategy is in place to protect his clients’ rights and interests effectively.

mariam-dovlatyan.name: Մարիամ Դովլաթյան
mariam-dovlatyan.biography:
Mariam Dovlatyan is a qualified advocate and a member of the Chamber of Advocates of the Republic of Armenia, with over four years of legal experience advising domestic and international clients on a broad range of business-related legal matters.

Her experience includes corporate and commercial law, employment, intellectual property, immigration, regulatory compliance, and civil and administrative matters. Her work has involved drafting and reviewing commercial agreements, advising on corporate governance and regulatory issues, assisting with cross-border matters, and representing clients in civil and administrative proceedings.

At Retrieve Legal & Tax, Mariam is further developing her practice in technology-related and regulatory matters. Her professional interests include information privacy and data protection, cybersecurity, and iGaming.

Mariam holds a Bachelor’s degree in Law and a Master’s degree in International Business Law from the French University in Armenia (UFAR) and has completed the Advocates Academy of the Republic of Armenia. She is currently completing an additional LL.M. in Law & Technology at King’s College London, with an academic focus on artificial intelligence, information privacy and data protection, and cybersecurity.

She works in Armenian, English, French, and Russian.

meline-nadaryan.name: Մելինե Նադարյան
meline-nadaryan.biography:
Meline is a lawyer with professional experience in legal practice, advising on a range of legal and administrative matters. She combines strong legal research and analytical skills with a practical, detail-oriented approach to addressing legal issues.

Her practice includes legal research and analysis, preparation and review of legal documents, corporate and administrative matters, and providing legal support in accordance with applicable legislation. She is committed to delivering clear, accurate, and practical legal solutions while maintaining high professional standards.

A graduate of Gavar State University with a Bachelor’s degree in Law, Meline is currently pursuing her Master’s degree in Law at the same university. She also studied Law with a specialization in International Law at the University of Valladolid in Spain, where she gained academic exposure to a European legal and multicultural environment.

Her professional interests include international law, human rights, corporate and regulatory matters, and legal research.
